Margit Brinck is a healthcare professional who works as a nurse at Odense University Hospital [^src1]. In the context of Danish national clinical quality improvement, she serves as a member of the steering group for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (The Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database) [^src1]. 

Her ongoing involvement in the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] is documented across multiple consecutive annual reports. She is officially listed as a steering group member in the 2023 report (which covers the period from July 2022 to June 2023) [^src1], the 2024 report [^src2], and the 2025 report [^src3]. Through her role on the steering group, Brinck contributes to the multidisciplinary and cross-sectoral governance of the database. This group is responsible for overseeing the data infrastructure and clinical quality indicators that aim to ensure uniform, evidence-based, and patient-centered care for individuals with atrial fibrillation across the Danish healthcare system [^src2].
